A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of the same OEA paper, with matching Sections 1–6, Appendices A–M, three figures, and 17 tables. Pagination changes do not obscure or remove material.

before.justification: v1 reports original retrieval experiments, efficiency measurements, human/LLM benchmark validation, and training–evaluation overlap analysis in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including retrieval comparisons, efficiency measurements, benchmark validation, and Appendix B's overlap analysis.

M1.justification: The shared multimodal backbone, LoRA adapters, projection heads, InfoNCE objective, embedding extraction, and hard-negative mining pipeline remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A and K.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same WavCaps/AudioCaps training, optional Clotho training, AudioCaps/Clotho/MECAT evaluation coverage, T2A/T2T tasks, and five UIQ types.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain LAION-CLAP, Robust-CLAP, MGA-CLAP, and M2D-CLAP. The vanilla Nemotron-3B and Qwen2.5-Omni 3B/7B comparisons also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Evaluation splits and sample counts, preprocessing, model configurations, training settings, retrieval metrics, and human/LLM validation procedures are unchanged. No new experimental protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The training/backbone comparisons, query-type analyses, and Appendix B leakage analysis are retained. No ablation, robustness test, error analysis, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Tables 1 and 7 retain the same validation-rating standard deviations and sample counts, and Section 3.2.3 retains the same correlation/significance reporting. Neither version adds repeated-run, seed, or confidence-interval information.

E6.justification: All reported table values and plotted results are unchanged. For example, M2D-CLAP's AudioCaps R@5 remains 77.13% in Table 2, and OEA-Qwen7B (+Cl)'s HNSR@10 remains 34.6% in Table 17.

T1.justification: Appendix A's InfoNCE equation and the discrimination-metric definitions in Section 3.3 and Appendix L are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, numbered contributions, and scientific conclusion retain the same OEA, UIQ, and discrimination-metric contributions and performance claims. The added resource-release notices do not alter these core scientific claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning semantic matching, exclusion understanding, deployment, synthetic-query bias, and backbone scaling are retained. The limitations concerning backbone compatibility, memory, mining bias, and query generation are unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 announces model-checkpoint release and provides a repository link for code, checkpoints, the demo, and UIQ benchmarks in footnote 1, with a release notice in the conclusion. v1 provided a benchmark/demo notice and demo-site link. Implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited research, reference list, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to CLAP models and prior query-robustness research remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 revises the introduction's resource-release paragraph and footnote, adds a concluding release sentence, and updates the version/date stamp. The remaining prose and section/appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: The additions cause text and float reflow, with Table 17 moving from v1's shared final page to a separate final page in v2. All three figure images and the table structures and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new code/checkpoint access information in footnote 1 and the conclusion improves resource discoverability and reproducibility guidance beyond v1's benchmark/demo notice. This is a limited documentation benefit: the scientific evidence is unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish the contents or usability of the linked resources.
